As a junior digital marketer based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, with hands-on experience in campaign support, event coordination, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your regional marketing efforts.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my organizational skills and attention to detail. Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Coordinator (Benelux & Nordics) position at your company. As a junior digital marketer based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, with a strong foundation in content creation, event coordination, and campaign support, I am eager to bring my skills to your international marketing team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in planning and delivering marketing activities. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. This role has sharpened my organizational skills and attention to detail, which are essential for coordinating regional campaigns and events. I have also collaborated with sales teams to ensure effective lead capture and follow-up, aligning marketing activities with commercial objectives.

One of my key projects, mirook.com, involved designing and building a multi-page website from scratch, implementing structured data, and running technical SEO audits. This project demonstrates my ability to manage multiple tasks, work independently, and deliver measurable results. I am comfortable using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and inform decisions.

I am fluent in English and Dutch (B1, currently improving), and I am based in Belgium, ready to travel across Benelux and occasionally to Sweden and the UK. My proactive, hands-on approach and willingness to learn make me a great fit for this role. I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to own regional marketing plans and work closely with sales, service, and clinical teams.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the possibility of contributing to your team and helping shape your brand's growth in the Benelux and Nordics.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
